mechanism: Pyrazinamide causes hyperuricemia and can precipitate gout; ferrous sulfate may worsen gastrointestinal irritation when combined, and pyrazinamide can impair iron absorption through altered gastric pH and GI effects.
action: Monitor for gastrointestinal symptoms and gout exacerbation; consider separating administration times by 2 hours and monitor serum iron/ferritin levels during concurrent therapy.
